summary.summary:
* Ethiopia's humanitarian response plans for 2025 are being updated. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4167767)

* Ethiopian farmers are adopting new practices to improve agriculture, as highlighted by the World Food Programme. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4167221)

* Key findings from the Ethiopia Solutions Index as of February 2025 are available. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4167201)
⚕️
* The Ethiopia Health Cluster Bulletin for June 2025 provides an update on the humanitarian health situation. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4167159)

* UNHCR reports on populations of concern in Ethiopia and the broader East, Horn of Africa, and Great Lakes region as of June 30, 2025. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4167025)

* Minutes from the Ethiopia WASH Cluster ETF meeting held on July 15, 2025, are available. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4166865)

* Ethiopia is experiencing severe weather conditions as reported by DG ECHO and partners as of July 23, 2025. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4166702)

* An infographic provides an overview of Ethiopia's humanitarian operations for June 2025. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4166413)

* The Ethiopia ES/NFI Cluster's mid-year report for 2025 details progress, challenges, and field insights. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4166067)

* A Joint Cash Feasibility Assessment was conducted in Ethiopia from March 3-14, 2025. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/node/4165835)

* A BBC Africa Eye investigation has exposed the involvement of "madams" in child sex trade in Kenya, particularly in the transit town of Maai Mahiu. [Source](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c15l9zl508eo)

* At least 68 African refugees and migrants, including 154 Ethiopians, died when their boat capsized off the coast of Yemen, with 74 others still missing. [Source](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/8/3/more-than-50-refugees-and-migrants-die-in-boat-sinking-off-yemeni-coast)

* Humanitarian access is improving in conflict-affected areas of northern Ethiopia, enabling aid delivery to vulnerable populations. [Source](https://www.unocha.org/ethiopia/story/humanitarian-access-improving-conflict-affected-areas)

* Emergency drought response operations are ongoing in Ethiopia, providing water, food, and shelter to affected rural communities. [Source](https://www.unocha.org/ethiopia/story/drought-response-emergency-support-rural-communities)

* Urgent funding is required for Ethiopia's humanitarian response as millions remain in need of assistance across various regions. [Source](https://www.unocha.org/ethiopia/story/urgent-funding-needed-humanitarian-response)
